### 12-Slot Organizer Stand

A simple two-level holder designed to keep up to 12 items securely in place. The top has 12 individual slots, while the matching bottom section supports each item to help prevent it from falling through.

Compact, practical, and great for keeping small items neatly organized on your desk or workspace.

🖨️ Easy to print
⭕ 12 slots
🔒 Bottom support keeps items secure
✨ Simple and functional design

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF)
